name: WHO prequalification (PQT/MED)

changes.notes: Nine more quiz questions in the shared module (every lesson now has at least eight). No rule changes.

about: The summary of product characteristics of a prequalified finished pharmaceutical product, published as Part 4 of the WHO Public Assessment Report (WHOPAR): an SmPC-style template whose last sections give the supplier, the WHO reference number, the date of prequalification and the date of revision.

sources.title: WHO PQT/MED: Contents and structure of a WHOPAR (Part 4 is the SmPC)
WHO PQT/MED: Section guidance, WHOPAR Part 4 (SmPC): 4.6, 4.8 frequency terms, 6.4 storage
Example of a published WHOPAR Part 4 (HA790): section headings 1 to 10 and the opening statement
